paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption: : Self-reflection SFT data statistic

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представлява стълбова диаграма, която илюстрира броя на примерите (samples) в различни категории на данни, използвани за саморефлексивно финетюнинг (self-reflection SFT) в контекста на мултимодални големи езикови модели. Хоризонталната ос (абсциса) показва категориите на разсъждаване, които са разположени в азбучен ред: "Mathematical Reasoning", "General Reasoning", "Natural Scene Reasoning", "Physical Reasoning", "Logical Puzzle Reasoning" и "Chemical Reasoning". Вертикалната ос (ордината) е етикетирана като "Number of Samples" и използва логаритмична скала, като етикетите показват стойности в степени на 10: 10² (100), 10³ (1000) и 10⁴ (10000). Стойностите на стълбите са директно означени върху върха на всеки стълб: "Mathematical Reasoning" има 7025 примера, "General Reasoning" – 1709, "Natural Scene Reasoning" – 413, "Physical Reasoning" – 232, "Logical Puzzle Reasoning" – 91 и "Chemical Reasoning" – 49. Стълбовете са изобразени в един и същ светлосин цвят, без визуално подчертаване или групиране, и са подредени по азбучен ред на категориите. Скалата по вертикалната ос е логаритмична, което позволява визуално представяне на широк диапазон от стойности, като разликата между най-високия и най-ниския стълб е значителна – от 7025 до 49 примера.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图展示了用于自我反思监督微调（Self-reflection SFT）数据集的各类推理任务样本数量统计，旨在反映不同推理类型在数据集中的分布情况。水平轴（x轴）表示六种不同的推理类别，从左到右依次为：Mathematical Reasoning、General Reasoning、Natural Scene Reasoning、Physical Reasoning、Logical Puzzle Reasoning 和 Chemical Reasoning，类别按字母顺序排列。垂直轴（y轴）表示“Number of Samples”（样本数量），采用对数刻度，范围从10²（100）到10⁴（10,000），刻度标记为10²、10³、10⁴，数值间隔为一个数量级。每个柱状图均为浅蓝色，高度对应其类别下的样本数量，柱顶标注了精确数值。Mathematical Reasoning类别拥有最多的样本，为7025；其次是General Reasoning，为1709；Natural Scene Reasoning为413；Physical Reasoning为232；Logical Puzzle Reasoning为91；Chemical Reasoning样本数量最少，为49。所有柱状图在视觉上未进行特殊强调（如加粗、阴影或轮廓），且无分组或堆叠结构，各柱独立排列，高度随样本数量递减而依次降低。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the number of samples across six different reasoning categories used in the self-reflection supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data for the SRPO framework, as described in the paper "SRPO: Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware Reinforcement Learning." The vertical axis, labeled "Number of Samples," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10² (100) to 10⁴ (10,000), with tick marks at 10², 10³, and 10⁴. The horizontal axis lists the reasoning categories in descending order of sample count: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning. Each category is represented by a light blue bar with its exact sample count labeled on top. Mathematical Reasoning has the highest number of samples at 7,025, followed by General Reasoning with 1,709, Natural Scene Reasoning with 413, Physical Reasoning with 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning with 91, and Chemical Reasoning with the fewest at 49. The bars are arranged left to right in decreasing order of sample size, and no additional visual emphasis (such as shading or annotations) is applied to any specific bar. The chart visually highlights a significant disparity in sample distribution, with Mathematical Reasoning having over 140 times more samples than Chemical Reasoning.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Anzahl der Datenbeispiele (Samples) für verschiedene Reasoning-Kategorien im Kontext der Selbstreflexion-SFT-Daten (Self-reflection Supervised Fine-Tuning) dar, wie im Papier „SRPO: Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware Reinforcement Learning“ beschrieben. Die horizontale Achse listet die Reasoning-Kategorien in absteigender Reihenfolge nach der Anzahl der Samples auf: „Mathematical Reasoning“, „General Reasoning“, „Natural Scene Reasoning“, „Physical Reasoning“, „Logical Puzzle Reasoning“ und „Chemical Reasoning“. Die vertikale Achse ist logarithmisch skaliert und beschriftet mit „Number of Samples“, mit Markierungen bei 10², 10³ und 10⁴. Die Balken sind einheitlich hellblau und zeigen die jeweiligen Werte direkt über dem Balken an: „Mathematical Reasoning“ hat 7025 Samples, „General Reasoning“ 1709, „Natural Scene Reasoning“ 413, „Physical Reasoning“ 232, „Logical Puzzle Reasoning“ 91 und „Chemical Reasoning“ 49. Die Balken sind in einer absteigenden Reihenfolge nach der Anzahl der Samples angeordnet, wobei der erste Balken am höchsten ist und der letzte am niedrigsten. Es gibt keine zusätzlichen visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen, Umrandungen oder Anmerkungen. Die Daten zeigen eine deutliche Abnahme der Sampleanzahl von der mathematischen zur chemischen Reasoning-Kategorie.
